basic_info.description: Sleek, renovated home just 4 blocks from West Portal Avenue, offering 2,661 sq. ft. across two levels. This turnkey residence features 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, thoughtfully redesigned with elegant finishes. The main level boasts a spacious living room with lime wash walls and a custom gas fireplace crafted from Collemandina marble, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. Both kitchens include a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Miele and Bosch appliances, Cristallo natural quartzite counters, and stylish cabinetry, perfect for entertaining or everyday living. Bathrooms showcase integrated sinks and refined finishes, while bedrooms feature updated details. New windows, skylights and light fixtures expand the sense of light. The main level offers 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The lower level includes 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a mini-kitchen, wine fridge, and an entertainment room with folding glass doors opening to a landscaped garden with sweeping Pacific Ocean views. Recent upgrades include new foundation, roof, plumbing, electrical and forced-air heating systems. Ideally located near West Portal, this home offers easy access to shops, dining, and transit. A rare opportunity to own a modernized home in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
